title: What Strengthens Protein-Protein Interactions: Analysis and Applications of Residue Correlation Networks
authors: Hung TI; Hsieh Y; Lu W; Wu K; Chang CA
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算建模分析残基相关网络来优化蛋白-蛋白相互作用，虽非TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作界面设计，故给予中档评分。
abstract: Identifying critical residues in protein-protein binding and efficiently designing stable and specific protein binders is challenging. In addition to direct contacts in a protein-protein binding interface, our study employs computation modeling to reveal the essential network of residue interaction and dihedral angle correlation critical in protein-protein recognition. We propose that mutating residues regions exhibited highly correlated motions within the interaction network can efficiently optimize protein-protein interactions to create tight and selective protein binders. We validated our strategy using ubiquitin (Ub) and MERS coronaviral papain-like protease (PLpro) complexes, where Ub is one central player in many cellular functions and PLpro is an antiviral drug target. Our designed UbV with 3 mutated residues resulted in a ∼3,500-fold increase in functional inhibition, compared with the wild-type Ub. Further optimization by incorporating 2 more residues within the network, the 5-point mutant achieved a K D of 1.5 nM and IC 50 of 9.7 nM. The modification led to a 27,500-fold and 5,500-fold enhancements in affinity and potency, respectively, as well as improved selectivity, without destabilizing the UbV structure. Our study highlights residue correlation and interaction networks in protein-protein interaction, introduces an effective approach to design high affinity protein binders for cell biology and future therapeutics solutions.
abstract_zh: 在蛋白质-蛋白质结合中识别关键残基，并高效设计稳定且特异的蛋白质结合物，是一项挑战。除了蛋白质-蛋白质结合界面中的直接接触外，我们的研究采用计算建模来揭示在蛋白质-蛋白质识别中至关重要的残基相互作用和二面角相关性的关键网络。我们提出，在相互作用网络内表现出高度相关运动的残基区域进行突变，可以高效优化蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，以生成紧密且选择性的蛋白质结合物。我们使用泛素（ubiquitin, Ub）和中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒木瓜样蛋白酶（papain-like protease, PLpro）复合物验证了我们的策略，其中Ub是许多细胞功能中的核心参与者，而PLpro是抗病毒药物靶点。我们设计的UbV含有3个突变残基，与野生型Ub相比，功能抑制能力提高了约3,500倍。通过在该网络内进一步整合2个残基进行优化，5点突变体达到了K D 为1.5 nM和IC 50 为9.7 nM。这一修饰使亲和力和效力分别增强了27,500倍和5,500倍，同时提高了选择性，且未破坏UbV结构的稳定性。我们的研究强调了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用中的残基相关性和相互作用网络，为细胞生物学和未来治疗解决方案设计高亲和力蛋白质结合物提供了一种有效方法。
